d: Couples are chained to a platform submerged 8 feet underwater  players struggle to hang on to each other while suspended from a spinning truss 20 feet in the air.
Couples compete in a series of challenges for a cash prize of $1 million  players grab at flags while hanging upside down from a helicopter. Host: Joe Rogan.
Men dive into a trash receptacle in search of disgusting food items for their mates to gobble up as quickly as possible.
While one person lies in a coffin with chicken feet and rats, the partner must remove as many chicken feet as possible, using only the mouth.
Three remaining couples vie for the $1 million prize  a passenger guides a blindfolded driver. Host: Joe Rogan.
Contestants swap revolting lumps of so-called food, then devour their final gift  players must swim underwater in a lake of fire.

st: Boat to Boat Transfer  Worm Wine  Matrix Truck Straddle
d: Contestants stomp worms in a vat in order to fill a glass with worm fluids, which they must drink  contestants attempt to walk between two speeding semi trucks.
